image.description: Present for backward compatibility; ignored on the match.

description:
Claim request body: the labels the worker presents (from its
`COMUKI_*` environment). The claiming worker's id comes from its
bearer token — never from the body.
string ClaimWorkItemRequest.EnvClass is REQUIRED (task 3.2): missing or empty is a
`400 worker.env_class.required`; the queue SQL filters
`env_class = @envClass`, so omitting it would silently miss
every claim. string? ClaimWorkItemRequest.Image is now OPTIONAL in the wire shape —
the item's image is pinned by the host at WorkItem.Create from the
project default, and the worker doesn't need to know it. Older workers
still post image; we keep accepting it and ignore it for the match.
